description: Unit tests for WebSocket frame header encoding, masking, opcodes, and related functions in the net namespace.

classes.name: WebSocketFrameHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a WebSocket frame, including opcode, final bit, reserved bits, payload length, and masking.

methods.name: WriteWebSocketFrameHeader
methods.description: Serializes a WebSocketFrameHeader into a buffer, optionally applying masking.

methods.name: MaskWebSocketFramePayload
methods.description: Applies masking or unmasking to WebSocket frame payload data based on the masking key and frame offset.
